proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10896 gives awāṇ laùkā and regional lōka forms under the -kk extension, and Nepali haluko under its metathesized series. Both belong to the stored *laghukk- section 10896-5. Exact survey form loka is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
